title: The Linux pull-agent answer names the flush an idempotent nft -f file needs and its own-table scope
goal: kb/public/_answers.md's two lines of the Linux pull-agent answer on nft -f (the one that says nft -f swaps a whole ruleset, plus the Conclusion's idempotent steps with one nft -f file) say a file needs a flush first and that flush table scopes it to the agent's own table, as the security/linux-nftables article (its lines 17, 23 and 36) now says. Found by the SP-tcis5f23 review (S3).

run: import pathlib,sys; ls=pathlib.Path('kb/public/_answers.md').read_text().splitlines(); sys.exit(any(('swaps a whole ruleset' in l or 'idempotent steps (one' in l) and 'flush table' not in l for l in ls))

import pathlib,sys; ls=pathlib.Path('kb/public/_answers.md').read_text().splitlines(); t=[l for l in ls if 'swaps a whole ruleset' in l or 'idempotent steps (one' in l]; sys.exit(0 if len(t)==2 and all('own table' in l for l in t) else 1)
